name: Animaniacs
description: Yakko, Wakko and Dot return for all-new big laughs and the occasional epic takedown of authority figures in serious need of an ego check. Joining the Warners are Starbox & Cindy on their latest play date while Pinky and the Brain's ideas for world domination lead them to all new adventures.

videos.title: Animaniacs x MasterClass - The Brain Teaches World Domination: Meet Your Instructor
videos.overview: You know him: the mouse, the myth, the legend. Now you can hear from Brain firsthand how he came to be the mastermind he is today, and how you can follow in his prodigious pawprints. Directed by his loyal assistant, Pinky, with only a few mishaps.

videos.title: Animaniacs x MasterClass - The Brain Teaches World Domination: Finding Your Assistant
videos.overview: It's Pinky's time to shine! If you want to add an assistant to your global domination schemes, you'll need to know Brain's tips for turning an underwhelming underling into your perfect complement. Featuring footage from a time when they were inseparable.

videos.title: Animaniacs x MasterClass - The Brain Teaches World Domination: Disguises and the Art of Subterfuge
videos.overview: As Brain always says, "appearances matter!" Learn the importance of using the right disguises and building your personal brand to achieve world domination. Plus, the return of the no-bake cheesecake.

videos.title: Animaniacs x MasterClass - The Brain Teaches World Domination: Analyzing Your Adversaries
videos.overview: In Brain's final class, he demonstrates how to find and capitalize on an opponent's weaknesses through a detailed analysis of his greatest foe. Plus, get some marketing tips from Pinky!
